You can do anything with magic if you use it right.
Father!
Oh, darling, what's the matter? Did you come up with a plan?
No, we're stumped. Go figure, eh?
I'm sorry. You seem to be bothered by something.
I can help if you want. Can you tell me what's wrong?
...Well, for the past few days...
Let me help, please!
What can a girl like you do?
Daddy, she knows how to cast magic spells!
Just leave everything to me! Your troubles are over!
You mean they've just begun!
Well, what about payment? Mercs don't work for free, you know.
You ought to be more worried about a Merc who works for free.
You got that right! Har har har!
What are you laughing about, you old geezer?!
Let's stay on the subject, OK? We must plan a counterattack!
I wish someone would do something.
Sorry, sorry. Sorry for being late.
I haven't quite got the knack of this Teleport Gem.
For a minute I thought I had teleported to the wrong place again.
Uh-oh. This isn't the Valeria household, is it? I knew it...
Excuse me, but...
Who are you, anyway?
What's weird is how they dump that stuff on rice to eat it!
That is just so gross!
Right?
Try this nice, warm treat.
Mmmmm...
There. Do you feel better now?
Sorry about the way I acted. I was just so nervous.
I just can't get the hang of the Teleport Gem, you know, an item used for moving around.
I'm studying magic, and this one item just seems to have it in for me or something.
Wow! You know how to use magic?!
A-Actually I'm still learning.
Wow, I'm so impressed!
Oh, don't be impressed. Anyone can use magic, y' know.
You mean, even I can learn magic?
Of course you can!
For instance, you can pick out a loved one's voice or your own name in a noisy room.
That's a kind of magic, too. Get it?
No, I don't get it.
No? Oh...
But you will someday. Magic is a power that anyone can use...
And magic can do anything.
I know how to use magic, too!
I'm going to be like you! I'll work hard and I won't give up -- ever!
I know how to use magic, too!
I'm going to be like you! I'll work hard and I won't give up -- ever!
We tried every trick in the book, but nothing worked.
This dark sky bodes ill. The Palace wheat won't grow...
Well, well. If it isn't the magic girl. Back again, eh?
Looking for the Raypoints to fix the sky, are you? Ha ha! It's a fine thing you're doing.
I don't know if this will help, but
It was so good of you to come to this remote little village.
Looking for the Raypoints to fix the sky, are you? Ha ha! It's a fine thing you're doing.
I don't know if this will help, but
The village was attacked maybe a week ago, perhaps.
I remember because it was the start of the wheat harvest.
It was so good of you to come so far. You must be tired. Please rest before you go on.
The rate is
Oh, I'm so sorry. You don't seem to have enough money.
Luckily we harvested the wheat before this monster problem.
Now the granary is full of Palace wheat!
We started patrolling after the monster problem began.
Tonight it's my turn. Argh, I'm just bushed.
We've got a selection of goods second to none! Come take a look.
We want to hire Mercs to kill the monsters.
I'm sure they can handle the monsters with no problem.
Hey, youngsters. You've racked up a few PS points, eh? Want to beef up your skills?
If we don't harvest the wheat, this village is done for!
I don't know anything about any Raypoint. But the Village Elder might know.
This is Palace Village. We're a small village dependent on the wheat harvest.
So where do you come from, young lady?
The harvest is in so we'll have enough food for awhile, but with the sky like this...
A Raypoint? Yes, the
We finished harvesting the all-important wheat that the village economy depends on.
The granary is chock full of the wheat we harvested.
No, it's too dangerous! Let the Mercs handle the monsters. They're professionals.
Even the Mercs can't do anything about the sky. Oh, what will become of us...
Hey, good to see you again! Thanks for all that you did! You really saved us all!
Did you come to see HIM? He's probably outside.
I told him not to go outside because of the strange sky but he just won't listen.
Welcome! It's been some time since a traveler stopped in.
The Mercs are adventurers who explore ancient ruins and hunt monsters for bounty.
They'd be perfect for a job like this.
Oh, hi! I'm so glad you're here!
Can you, um, fix the sky with your magic?
Hi! They say you're a friend of that girl. Will you be my friend, too?
Oh, hello! It's me! Don't you remember?
You don't? Oh, I'm crushed. To think that my first love forgot me.
You kept your promise and came back like you said! I'm so happy!
I'd be even happier if the sky wasn't so weird now.
Oh, hello. This is Palace Village. A young girl who knew magic came to help us.
Those scary monsters only attack the wheat fields.
At least no one in the village has been harmed so far.
But my dad is out patrolling to make sure those monsters don't try anything.
Gathering information is the key to success in adventuring.
So why not start by asking the villagers what they know?
A traveler needs strong magic. Make spells here if you have some extra Crests.
Oh, no... When will all our troubles finally come to an end?
We finished harvesting the all-important wheat that the village economy depends on.
The wheat we harvested is in the granary over there, in the northeast part of the village.
Well, you're my first customer in a quite a while. Let me jazz up that ARM of yours.
You don't have to reload. Just blast away all you want!
It costs
Whoops. Looks like you don't have enough money. Come back after you get more Gella.
I won't just load the ARM, I'm gonna modify it, too, alright?
In all my travels this is the first time I've experienced anything like this.
Since the sky darkened, I think the monsters have increased in number.
The monsters always come from the northeast.
The northeast is an unlucky direction. Bad things always come from the northeast.
And guess where the granary in Palace Village is. Right. In the northeast part of town.
I hear the villagers want to hire Mercs to get rid of the monsters.
But there aren't many Mercs who'd come to a backwater like this village.
I know what's going on!
I heard they used a strong curse to get the monsters out of the wheat fields.
I wish they'd settle down and make the sky normal again.
I know what's going on!
The curse they used to get the monsters out of the fields is what's making the sky weird!
I saw the whole thing!
I saw a huge monster chomping wheat right in the middle of the wheat fields!
Next it's the villagers who are going to be eaten! I just know it!
This sky is bad news for me.
In times like this, they always sacrifice the prettiest girl, and that's me. Oh, poor me!
The cause of the weird sky?
The old lady says it's a curse but I think God is jealous of of me for being so pretty.
The monsters?
I kept saying I would get rid of them, but mom and dad wouldn't let me.
It's because I'm so pretty.
Oh, this better not be the end of the world.
I won't allow it! I haven't met my Prince Charming yet!
First monsters in the fields, then the sky darkens. Doesn't anyone care about me?
Strictly speaking, it is the wheat, not the village, that is being attacked.
The monsters are raiding our wheat. What's wrong with looking at it that way?
I pray that when our food runs low, the villagers don't kill each other over what's left.
In times like these, you have to manage your food supply properly.
It was about... yes, exactly a week ago that the village was first attacked.
I remember it well because we were busy harvesting the Palace wheat.
This is the village granary. It holds our precious supply of wheat.
This horrible-looking sky is worse than the monsters.
Hello again. Did you teleport to your destination safely?
As you see, the sky turned weird, but I welcome it.
I hope that girl who saved our village is alright. Oh, let me explain.
A girl came to our village and saved us from the monsters. She was a spunky little thing.
The monsters were frightening things, but luckily no one in the village was harmed.
Only our fields were damaged... so far.
Forget about magic! Close-in combat calls for weapons! Are you guys equipped for it?
OK, let's just sum up what we know, alright?
The monsters aren't after the village or the villagers. They are after the wheat harvest.
No one has been hurt. The damage is limited to the wheat and the wheat field.
Come to think of it, the monsters always appear in the northeast.
They're back! The monsters! The monsters are attacking!
They're after the granary!
Hurry!
Don't panic! Just find someplace safe to hide!
I'll take care of the monsters... with my magic!
W-We did it! We beat them!
Young lady, you drove them off all by yourself?
That's amazing! Young lady, you're incredible!
Wow, your magic is powerful after all!
I said YEAH! |V| for victory, sucka!

I'm so glad you woke up.
You were sleeping so deeply, I thought you'd never wake up.
Where am I?
You're in T'Bok Village. In a stable.
But all the horses are gone.
My name's Merrill. Now can I ask you something?
Is this puppy your friend?
This is a very smart dog.
He is the one who told me you were passed out in the rain.
What's this dog's name?
So, your name is {7}. I like that name!
No, I haven't seen him before.
So I guess I can name him. Let's see...
OK, from now on your name is {7}. Do you like it?
I'm sorry, but I have to leave this village right away.
Why? You still need to rest!
Wait! I'll get you something to eat.
You're not afraid of me?
{7} says you're not a bad man.
Isn't that right, {7}?
Hey! You can't do that in this village!
Our intention was not to cause such a stir. What we do is for the sake of your village.
Stay here, mister.
Don't worry, {7} and I will stay with you!
There aren't any bad people in this village!
Hiding him will only bring your village misfortune.
Surely you realize that.
Hey, mister!
My name's not |mister.| 'Sides, it makes me sound old.
So there you are.
So it's you,
So you want to take us on?
That's fine by me, but realize that innocent villagers may be hit by stray bullets.
Seize him!
I'm sorry we have to do this. We're all from this village.
Was that man a bad man?
A bad man? Ho ho! You got it all wrong.
Now listen, young lady. That man is a |hero.|
A |hero|?
Ha ha ha! Ho ho ho!
Business's been bad since the civil war ended 5 years ago. Please buy what you need here!
Your magazine is full already. Don't get greedy!
Want your ARM fully loaded? That'll cost
I'll do business with anyone but only if they have money! Come back after you get some!
Come again, alright?
I'm sorry, but if you want to see the Village Elder, you'll have to come back later.
He's helping the wounded now.
Oh, hi, Mister. Guess what? Something good happened today.
So I'm off to a
The good thing that happened? You came here, that's what!
Hey, Mister.
Did you come to the village just to visit {4}?
Oops. What am I saying? I-I'm sorry!
Hello, everyone! Welcome and thanks for coming!
Mister, when {4} gets better, does that mean you won't come here anymore?
Oops. What am I saying? Sorry! Never mind!
Hi, Mister!
{4}'s condition hasn't changed. Neither has the dark sky.
Hello, everyone!
{4}'s condition hasn't changed. Neither has the dark sky.
Hello, Mister! I'm glad you came!
Hey... You look different. You look a lot healthier.
I'm so... um, the whole village is scared 'cause the sky turned black.
Now that you are here, we will feel a lot better. That's 'cause you're heroes!
Hey, Mister...
Why did you just disappear like that? You didn't even say goodbye!
I'm so glad you're alright.
Please, everyone, keep an eye on him so he doesn't do anything like that again!
Hey, where did |Mister| go...?
Oh, where did he go? Why isn't he with you?
I'm so glad you're alright.
I was so worried! I didn't know where you went or even if you were alright!
I first met him 5 years ago going into the village.
{7} told me he had collapsed in the rain. Hard to believe that was 5 years ago.
Sorry, but {4} hasn't recovered yet.
I'm so ashamed I can't do anything for you even though you protected our village.
Sorry, but {4} hasn't recovered yet.
I'm so ashamed that I can't do anything for the friends of
The sky is as dark as ever.
It weighs heavy on the hearts of everyone in the village.
My biggest worry about the sky is how it affects the people.
This place was dreary enough as it was, but this dark sky is sapping everyone's energy!
Merrill has been worried. Go show her you're safe.
Merrill will be so relieved to see that you're safe,
I see... So the situation outside is that bad...
In this remote village, we see little of worldly goings-on.
Hey!
I am grateful for what you did on that day 5 years ago.
Without your help, we could not have escaped.
It was so kindhearted of you to surrender for our sake.
A suspicious group had come to the village just before you.
They robbed us of the village's only boat. That was our only means of transport.
I am sure that {4} will be back to normal when the sky comes back.
It seems we must be strong and have faith that some day our beloved blue sky will return.
All I can do is believe that the blue sky will return. There is nothing else I can do.
There are still no signs of recovery, but I have hope.
As his dearest friend, please come visit {4} in the hope he will recover.
To be honest with you, {4} shows no signs of recovery yet.
But now that
I guess
{4} will be so disappointed.
I see. So, you are a friend of {4}'s.
Don't worry about {4}. We'll take good care of him.
That shady group just stole the village's boat. Fortunately, no one was hurt.
They seemed to be heading for
Every day, she's so anxious, wondering if today will be the day
She reminds me of me when I was awaiting my husband's return.
Just seeing that dark sky fills me with dread. Maybe I'm just being too paranoid.
What? You are trying to find a way to return the sky to normal?
That's wonderful! Please let us know what we can do! We'll do anything!
Merrill also seems relieved to see that you're alright,
That Merrill. She worries about you so much, you know!
My daughter, Merrill, had no playmates her own age. You were her only friend, {7}.
Your friendship means so much to her. Please be good to her!
Merrill has worried about you constantly for the past 5 years. I'm so glad to see you!
The whole village is so glad you're alright,
Especially my daughter, Merrill. There wasn't a day she didn't think of you.
The water level in the well seems lower recently.
The water has never run low before. Why now? Does this have something to do with the dark sky?
The village is near the sea and the forest, but has bad soil. It soaks up water quickly.
So far the darkening of the sky hasn't had any major effect on the village.
There's nothing to BE affected!
The village is so poor, the young people have all left for the big towns.
The only ones left here are a handful of those who love the place too dearly to leave it.
Long ago, soldiers of the Slayheim Liberation Army wandered into the village.
They just rested briefly and then went on. I don't know if they ever made it to safety.
I heard the gang who stole the boat talking to each other.
They plan to go
They took the village's only boat -- a small, old style one. We need that boat!
Just the other day, a traveling salesman told me that Odessa had been wiped out a long time ago.
That shows just how behind the rest of the world this village is.
What could be making the sky so dark? Tell us if you know!
Wayfarers like ya are our only source of information about the outside world, ya know.
The village is way behind the outside world. That's why the young people all leave here.
You a friend of {4}, the guy staying with the Village Elder?
When the fighting is over, why not stay here? This is a nice, peaceful place.
We all look forward to your visits here.
Stop by again on your way through these parts. We'll be waiting for you!
With the young folk gone, the village won't last much more.
We're the last residents. We should consider it an honor.
You! We already gave you our boat! Now get the hell out of here!
What? So you're not with those ruffians who took our boat? Oh, I'm sorry.
Those thieves were heading for the
The light... ...it's expanding...
Wow...
[Dumbfounded silence]
What could that light be? ...{4}...
Hee hee hee! Ha ha ha ha!
The sky... is falling...
Argh... The darkness in... the sky... is spreading...
Vins... Argh! I am...
I am... Who am I?
Hic! Hic!
Stay away... It's too dangerous! No! No! No, no, no!
People... ... people break... Ha ha ha...
Ugh... T-The light... It...
Ugh... Arrghh!
We must have been destined to meet here! You can't have too many items, I always say!
Is something the matter?
It's nothing. Forget it. Let's keep following those guys.
Well, well. Fancy this.
Stop that this instant! Don't bother the travelers with all your horseplay!
Oh, hi, Mister!
I said my name isn't |Mister.|
Is that you?
Is it you, {7}?
I knew it was you, Mister!
It's me, Merrill! You remember me, right?
Uh, of course I do.
But you've changed so much...
It's been 5 years. Wouldn't it be strange if I hadn't?
All this time, I had hoped that we would get the chance to meet again.
How could you forget {7}? I know it's been 5 years, but still...
Let's see, you must be...
It's me, Merrill. Not the same Merrill you knew before. I'm 17 now.
We all have to look our age - including {7} and me.
All this time, I had hoped that we would get the chance to meet again.
After you left, Mister, I asked why everyone called you a |hero.|
And I asked why a hero like you would be chased down and captured like that.
But you're not a bad man anymore, right, Mister? That's why you're here now, right?
No. I'm still a prisoner.
I've been a prisoner ever since that day.
I wanted to see you so that I could show you someone.
After you were taken away, {7} told me he was in the forest, unconscious.
I think he was in the Slayheim Liberation Army, like you.
This is the place. Come on inside.
Well I'll be...
Do you know him?
That I do.
Oh, thank goodness.
He had this on him. This is his name, right?
He's a very close friend of mine.
I'm happy for you.
But he must have amnesia from his fever and injuries.
He keeps mumbling that his name is
Oh, well. If he's your friend, that's enough for me.
I know you're glad to see your friend, but I have bad news.
We weren't able to heal him... in body or mind.
It's enough for me that I got to see him alive.
I mean, I'm grateful to you.
Slayheim expanded its military against the people's wishes.
Many small rebel groups staged scattered uprisings, but they were too unorganized.
There then appeared a man who united the opposition into the Slayheim Liberation Army.
That man's name was Vinsfeld Rhadamanthus.
That's...the name of my former commanding officer.
Holy cow... So
But Vinsfeld is the ringleader of Odessa.
Why would the Liberation Army leader turn terrorist?
I heard people in my village say it was Vinsfeld's...
charisma and the bravery of
...that enabled the Liberation to defeat the military despite their small numbers.
He and I were always fighting side by side.
But he disappeared during the Final Operation.
When the fighting was over...
we Liberation Army veterans were blamed for the entire war. We were treated like war criminals.
That's right. It was all a clever trap set and sprung by Vinsfeld.
Wow...
I don't care what anyone says. {7} and I know you're not a bad man.
Didn't you surrender to spare our village, five years ago?
Besides, you helped the recruits from our village at Greenhell, right?
No one in the village thinks you're a bad man, Mister.
So 5 years later...
I return to this village which should have been the site of my grave.
That scumbag Vinsfeld formed Odessa and came back before me!
He betrayed me AND my friends. I'll never forgive him!
But why did you keep quiet about this for so long?
Who'd think you were once friends with our enemy, Vinsfeld?
I'm sorry.
I thought it was between him and me. I wanted to settle it myself.
I never intended to involve you in my private vendetta.
Hey, we're all comrades in ARMS, right?
That makes you our buddy, right,
So what if you and Vinsfeld were buddies then,
That's right.
I'm a member of ARMS, sworn enemy of Odessa.
Let's focus on the present.
The thieves who stole the data tablets were traced to this village.
Just ahead is the ocean. They must have crossed the sea to the continent. Makes sense?
The desert in the northwest is where Slayheim once was.
Knowing Vinsfeld, he could be using the abandoned facilities there as a base of operations.
There's a town called Quartly near there. We should start gathering information there.
But it'll be hard to get to Slayheim without a boat.
And we left the Hovercraft a long ways from here.
Then Quartly it is. It's a long shot, but the best we have.
Tomorrow we'll figure out a way to get to Slayheim. There has to be a way.
That {7} is a handful.
He has the strange habit of collecting junk and bringing it to people he likes.
Look! The data tablets!
They've been destroyed.
So they realized we were using their pattern to track them.
Whoever did this knew a lot about data tablets.
They erased the memory.
It looks like the trail runs cold here.
Time for good, old-fashioned marching. On to Slayheim!
What's this? It's a teleport item.
With this, we can teleport to any town that we've visited at least once before.
But I never did have much luck with this type of item.
I can store records of your adventure! Isn't that great?
Unfortunately, this service is unavailable in the Demo Version.
I can store records of your adventure on a MEMORY CARD.
I have no luck with women but I'm a pro at fixing ARMs. Let me see yours.
Bullets are made to be used. So blast away and come back to me when you run out.
It costs
Sorry, but you're short on cash. See ya next time.
Come again, OK? You're about the only one here who will let me tinker with his ARM!
Right about now, you're itching to create a spell, right? I knew it!
A famous Merc once shopped here... or so they say. This is THE place for items.
Personal Skills are cool! So don't put it off. Challenge yourself!
We're closed today 'cause it's a special day for
Sorry, but we're closed today. It's a special occasion and we're celebrating.
Be careful! Oh, you worry me so much...
What a strong-looking friend.
This bread might not fill you up, but go ahead and eat as much as you want.
I bet you'll really like my jelly rolls!
Good morning,
A friend is waiting at the front. (This guy had friends?)
Oh, I just remembered.
You can get onto the roof from the 2nd floor here.
That reminds me.
The ceremony hall is far away. Eat something before you go. Try my homemade bread!
Did that hit the spot?
I'm sorry for keeping you so long.
Try my bread before you go.
You like it, don't you. I knew it!
Mr. Valeria is a nobleman, so watch your tongue!
You like my bread,
It's my new invention: jelly rolls! I make them by putting jelly into the bread dough.
Don't keep your friends waiting. Hurry up and go!
You spend more time like this than on dangerous missions.
This reminds me of when you were a child.
I'm glad you came back so soon, but...
Didn't you go to the ceremony? You're going to be in trouble!
Sword Cathedral is at the
The Valeria Chateau is, like, a great big thing at the
This is just crazy. I swear, there are more monsters around than before.
If you're going to leave town, you'd better be careful.
The monsters around here are nothing to be sneezed at.
Oh,
I know I shouldn't say this, but you should feel lucky to be the sole survivor.
Besides, I wouldn't want to see {2} heartbroken.
You a friend of
It's darned tasty!
The bread they sell is the best anywhere.
When I think that {2} made this with her own hand...
So I don't wanna hear that the old lady makes it, OK? That would ruin the fantasy.
Hey, Dude!
Hey, I'm so glad you're alright!
You're really something! You KO'd those bad-ass monsters at the ruins!
Oh, so you're the Dude's friend.
I didn't know the Dude had any friends other than me.
Dude, you are totally cool! I'm hella happy for you!
Oh, so you're the Dude's friend.
I didn't know the Dude had any friends other than me.
You gotta help, Dude. You're the only one I can turn to!
In my humble opinion...
In my humble opinion...
In my humble opinion...
... you should go straight to the ceremony instead of dilly-dallying like this.
In my humble opinion...
...since we were unable to retrieve it ourselves, we have no shred of honor left.
Hey, I heard you had a hell of a rough time! Hey, but at least you're alive!
Young people like you have to put up with their share of hard knocks, right?
When I was young, I... (snip)
Well, what a lovely outfit you have on.
When I was young, I... (snip)
When I hear your exploits I remember my younger days.
When I was young, I... (snip)
Hello, stranger. Say, you must be a traveler? Traveling is a good thing.
When I was young, I... (snip)
Hey, you really showed your stuff during that kidnapping!
That's good! 'Cuz when you're young, sometimes you gotta go wild, right?
When I was young, I... (snip)
Why,
Why, hello young lady. I heard you're a sorceress or a witch, but you don't have a broom...
I heard the innkeeper's roof has a hole in it because someone tromped all over it.
What a terrible thing to do.
That mischievous cat! Whatever it finds it takes right up onto the roof.
Hello, young feller. Say, are your wounds all better now?
You know, you shouldn't worry {2} too much.
That's an unusual outfit you're wearing. You're not from here, are you, young lady?
One minute you're confined to quarters, then they promote you. Talk about night and day!
Say, are you a friend of
Well, then, tell him I said not to overdo it, OK?
Hey, you're confined to quarters! If you get caught here, you'll catch hell!
They say terrorism increases with globalization. Are we getting more global?
In Filgaia, there are 3 other countries besides Meria Boule.
There's the forest kingdom, Sylvaland. And industrial Guild Galad. Then there's...
